AccelerationSettings.description: Accelerated transcoding can significantly speed up jobs with long, visually complex content.

Mode.description: Specify the conditions when the service will run your job with accelerated transcoding.

HopDestination.description: Optional. Configuration for a destination queue to which the job can hop once a customer-defined minimum wait time has passed.

Priority.description: Optional. When you set up a job to use queue hopping, you can specify a different relative priority for the job in the destination queue.

Queue.description: Optional unless the job is submitted on the default queue. When you set up a job to use queue hopping, you can specify a destination queue.

WaitMinutes.description: Required for setting up a job to use queue hopping. Minimum wait time in minutes until the job can hop to the destination queue.

JobMessages.description: Provides messages from the service about jobs that you have already successfully submitted.

Info.description: List of messages that are informational only and don't indicate a problem with your job.

Warning.description: List of messages that warn about conditions that might cause your job not to run or to fail.

OutputGroupDetail.description: Contains details about the output groups specified in the job settings.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with the job.

Key.description: The key name of the tag.

Timing.description: Information about when jobs are submitted, started, and finished is specified in Unix epoch format in seconds.

FinishTime.description: The time, in Unix epoch format, that the transcoding job finished.

StartTime.description: The time, in Unix epoch format, that transcoding for the job began.

SubmitTime.description: The time, in Unix epoch format, that you submitted the job.

VideoDetail.description: Contains details about the output's video stream.

HeightInPx.description: Height in pixels for the output.

WidthInPx.description: Width in pixels for the output.

schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::MediaConvert::Job. A MediaConvert job converts an input file into an output file or files.

AccelerationStatus.description: Describes whether the current job is running with accelerated transcoding.

Arn.description: An identifier for this resource that is unique within all of AWS.

BillingTagsSource.description: Optional. Choose a tag type that AWS Billing and Cost Management will use to sort your AWS Elemental MediaConvert costs on any billing report that you set up.

CreatedAt.description: The time, in Unix epoch format in seconds, that the job was created.

HopDestinations.description: Optional. Use queue hopping to avoid overly long waits in the backlog of the queue that you submit your job to.

Id.description: A portion of the job's ARN, unique within your AWS Elemental MediaConvert resources.

JobTemplate.description: Optional. When you create a job, you can either specify a job template or specify the transcoding settings individually.

Priority.description: Optional. Specify the relative priority for this job. In any given queue, the service begins processing the job with the highest value first.

Queue.description: Optional. When you create a job, you can specify a queue to send it to. If you don't specify, the job will go to the default queue.

Role.description: The IAM role you use for creating this job. For details about permissions, see the User Guide topic at the User Guide at https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mediaconvert/latest/ug/iam-role.html.

SettingsJson.description: JobSettings contains all the transcode settings for a job. Specified as an opaque JSON object, matching the representation used by AWS::MediaConvert::JobTemplate and AWS::MediaConvert::Preset.

ShareStatus.description: Indicates whether the job is sharable with AWS Support.

SimulateReservedQueue.description: Optional. Enable this setting when you run a test job to estimate how many reserved transcoding slots (RTS) you need.

Status.description: A job's status can be SUBMITTED, PROGRESSING, COMPLETE, CANCELED, or ERROR.

StatusUpdateInterval.description: Optional. Specify how often MediaConvert sends STATUS_UPDATE events to Amazon CloudWatch Events.

Tags.description: Optional. The tags that you want to add to the resource.

UserMetadata.description: Optional. User-defined metadata that you want to associate with an MediaConvert job.
